recognize_zh: 中央一顆組織球，胞質深藍、邊緣不規則，自身核被推到上方呈新月狀，胞質內包著一顆分葉的顆粒球核與粉紅色顆粒物質；組織球吞噬完整的骨髓細胞，是 HLH 典型的噬血現象。
features: Histiocyte with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and irregular, ragged borders
Histiocyte nucleus compressed into a crescent at the upper pole
Engulfed granulocyte with a dark lobulated nucleus within the cytoplasm
Adjacent pink-red granular material, likely ingested granulocyte granules or red cell debris
Background: an immature granulocyte with azurophilic granules (upper left) and crenated red cells from slow drying
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a histiocyte with abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm whose own nucleus is displaced into a crescent by ingested material. The cytoplasm contains an intact granulocyte with a dark lobulated nucleus and adjacent pink granular debris. An immature granulocytic cell and crenated red cells are present in the background. The findings represent hemophagocytosis; since isolated hemophagocytes are nonspecific, a diagnosis of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis requires correlation with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria.

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis after transfusion or infection
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical hemophagocytes occur without HLH; the syndrome is defined by clinical/laboratory criteria rather than by finding such a cell.

ddx.dx: Cell overlapping a monocyte or myelocyte
ddx.vs: Overlap lacks nuclear displacement of the host cell and a surrounding vacuole, whereas here the host nucleus is compressed by the ingested cell.
Megakaryocytes are larger with granular lilac cytoplasm and a multilobated nucleus, unlike this basophilic histiocyte with a crescentic nucleus.

ddx.dx: Leukemic blasts with cannibalism (e.g., AML with t(8;16))
ddx.vs: Erythrophagocytosis or leukophagocytosis by blasts shows immature host cells with fine chromatin and nucleoli rather than a mature histiocyte.
